from pathlib import Path
p=Path('minimal.bpf.o').read_bytes()
# parse ELF64 little
import struct
assert p[:4]==b'\x7fELF'
e_shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',p,0x28)[0]
e_shentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,0x3a)[0]
e_shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,0x3c)[0]
e_shstrndx=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,0x3e)[0]
shstr_off=struct.unpack_from('<Q',p,e_shoff+e_shstrndx*e_shentsize+0x18)[0]
shstr_size=struct.unpack_from('<Q',p,e_shoff+e_shstrndx*e_shentsize+0x20)[0]
shstr=p[shstr_off:shstr_off+shstr_size]
for i in range(e_shnum):
    off=e_shoff+i*e_shentsize
    nameoff=struct.unpack_from('<I',p,off)[0]
    name=shstr[nameoff:shstr.find(b'\0',nameoff)].decode()
    if name in ['.BTF.ext','.BTF']:
        sh_offset=struct.unpack_from('<Q',p,off+0x18)[0]
        sh_size=struct.unpack_from('<Q',p,off+0x20)[0]
        print(name, i, hex(sh_offset), hex(sh_size), 'shdr', hex(off))
PY
